However, 57.0% annualized 10-day realized volatility, 6.18% ATR, and 0.658 maximum selected correlation make it a high-variance exposure. Its price is only about 0.8% above the entry threshold, while required intraday volume confirmation fails. ON remains above its earlier position-entry trigger but below its newer $86.09 trigger, which is likewise unconfirmed due to zero reported volume; this provides no basis to increase aggregate exposure.

Weak regional-bank relative performance, a firmer dollar, and higher rates are adverse to broad risk-taking despite low VIX-level conditions and near-flat major-index moves. This mixed, internally fragile backdrop permits only confirmed range-breakout execution, not relaxed confirmation standards.
